en-GB.description:
Build Better Habits, One Day at a Time

iTrackHabit is a calm, beautifully designed habit tracker that runs entirely on your device. There is no account to create and no server to sign in to — open the app and start tracking.

Genuinely Private
• Works completely offline; your habits never leave your device
• No account, no sign-up, no cloud
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking of any kind
• Your habits leave your device only when you export them

Beautiful & Intuitive Design
• Stunning neumorphic interface that's easy on the eyes
• Smooth animations and delightful interactions
• Clean, distraction-free experience
• Light and dark mode

Smart Habit Tracking
• Track daily, weekly, or custom frequency habits
• Set specific targets (time, count, or custom metrics)
• Visual progress rings and completion tracking
• Start from a habit template or build your own
• A focus timer for habits you sit down to do

Insights That Stay on Your Device
• Beautiful charts showing your progress over time
• Streak tracking and completion rates
• Personalised patterns and suggestions, calculated locally from your own records

Motivation & Achievements
• Earn badges for consistency and milestones
• Build impressive streaks
• Celebrate every step of your progress

Yours to Keep
• Export everything to a JSON or CSV file whenever you like
• Import it back on a new device
• Optional Face ID or Touch ID lock for the app
• Send us feedback straight from the app

Perfect for:
• Building exercise routines
• Developing meditation practices
• Learning new skills
• Drinking more water
• Reading daily
• Any positive habit you want to establish

Completely free, with every feature unlocked. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no premium tier.

Start building the life you want, one habit at a time.
en-GB.promoText: A calm habit tracker that works entirely offline. No account, no ads, no tracking — just your habits, on your device. Start today!

review.notes:
## Note for the reviewer

No sign-in is required. iTrackHabit has no accounts and no login screen; opening the app takes you straight to the habit list, and every feature is available immediately.

The app is fully offline. Habits and their history are stored on the device in a local SQLite database. There is no user account, and habit data never leaves the device, so the app works with airplane mode on. The one network request is optional: Profile → Send feedback posts the message the user writes (plus device model and OS, which they can switch off) to our feedback inbox.

There is no paid tier, no subscription, and no in-app purchase. Every feature is free and unlocked.

**How to try it in about a minute**

1. Open the app. Two starter habits are created on first launch.
2. Tap the circle on the right of a habit row to mark it done, the ring at the top updates immediately.
3. Tap "+" to add a habit, or use Templates to pick a prepared one.
4. Open the Insights and Awards tabs to see charts and achievements. These fill out as habits are completed, so on a fresh install they will be mostly empty — this is expected, not a defect.
5. Profile → Export & backup writes the data to a JSON or CSV file, and only when you tap it.
6. Profile → Send feedback sends a message to us. This is the only data the app sends anywhere.

**Permissions**

The app asks for notification permission only, and only to schedule local habit reminders. These are local notifications; there is no push server and no device token is sent anywhere.

Profile → Privacy & security offers an optional biometric app lock. It is **off by default** and must be switched on deliberately, so it will not block review. If you do enable it, the system passcode works as a fallback.

**Data and privacy**

No account, no analytics, no advertising, no third-party SDKs collecting data. Only feedback the user chooses to send is stored server-side; uninstalling the app removes all of its data. Account deletion requirements under 5.1.1(v) do not apply, as no account is ever created.

Thank you for reviewing.
